reviews.t: military standards and all this had perfect dimensions. All it is is the same as ...
reviews.x: I ordered this because I just cut my hair short and I wanted the option to wear a bun for days I don't have time to straighten my hair for work, military standards and all this had perfect dimensions. All it is is the same as a foam bun maker that you're supposed to wrap your own hair around, I was expected a hair price that I could clip on top of my small pony tail. I just have read the description wrong when I ordered it, so don't make the same mistake I did! Otherwise seems decent for quality

I like these because it makes the bun perfect and fast. You don't have to worry about it not matching if you have brown or close to brown hair. This has worn a lot faster than the one that I had previously. Also, in the middle where you pull your real hair threw, was kind of "ratty" from day one. It makes it harder to pull your hair threw and I actually believe that's why it wore down faster.

reviews.t: Great for short and long hair! 🌸
reviews.x: In the military and currently working on growing my hair out after having a short bob. Various colors and looks great. Easy to use, and has held up great this last month being used 5-6 times a week. Plan to continue using even once my hair gets longer since it is much sleeker and stays cleaner than the regular mesh sock bun inserts I used to use before. Will post pics next time I go to work.

Love this bun shaper. My hair is thinning, so there isn't enough to drape over donut bun shapers. With the mesh ones you could see the mesh which I hated. With this one, any parts my hair doesn't cover just looks like a different color hair (I ordered light brown, but it's more of a copper color when you receive it). So it looks like I have copper highlights, which I'm ok with. I definitely recommend this opposed to any mesh donut bun shapers.  UPDATE: After 5 months of use, this thing is on its

I bought the blonde which turns out to be bright yellow,  shiny Barbie hair. I remedied this quite nicely using Fanciful bashful blonde rinse on the bun. I like  this so much more than a typical bun maker which  always popping through as my hair is fine. This is so much easier to disguise.  I also took another reviewer's idea and used dry shampoo to tone down the shine.

reviews.t: However I didn't find it very difficult to wrap my own hair around it like some of the other reviews said
reviews.x: The hair is a bit slick in this fake bun. However I didn't find it very difficult to wrap my own hair around it like some of the other reviews said. My hair is fine and is straight.  The only difference was having to take my time putting in the bun .  The other bun helpers I have, grip the hair so I can put my hair up faster but not enough to where I wouldn't recommend purchasing this. I like the fact I didn't have to worry about the bun helper showing through because it matched my hair

reviews.t: Great when the hair is still on the bun, but a mess after you've used it one too many times
reviews.x: I really enjoyed this while it lasted.  However, in hindsight I should've known that it wouldn't last that long.  I had used this product just as you would any sock bun.  That said, I would secure my hair with bobby pins to keep everything in place.  After probably a month of semi-regular use, the hair on the bun started fraying.  At first it wasn't bad, but soon the hair was just a loose mess. What I mean by that is the hair was no longer affixed to the bun, instead it was just loose like a lit

reviews.t: This is a donut for a bun, not something that goes over one.
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:209e79d1bfbc35d983da0a8d2fa01f66]] So I read this as it was something to go over a bun. I have small hair so my buns are tiny. If I had known this was just another donut to pull your hair thru and pin it, I wouldn't have bought it. It works as any other donut, except this has hair over it, which kind of helps if you have thin hair. I havr auburn hair and got the light brown and it matches pretty well.

Great item for the price. This is definitely functional for making an adorable top knot. I was surprised by how gold it was, I expected it to be more platinum or beige, and it's synthetic hair so it's much shinier than natural hair. I sprayed it down with dry shampoo and styling powder to tone down the shine and add grip which balanced out the color too so it wasn't so buttery

reviews.t: This blends beautifully. Good for thin hair.
reviews.x: Based on the images, I thought it would be larger... but still, it's nice for those with thin hair. The old spongey ones I had would show right through, but this blends beautifully.

This bun maker arrived quickly, as described, and feels durable. Used it three times in the past 24 hours (different hairstyles).  Very pleased with its ease of use and the way that it blends into the hair, which is more a grey-brown color than a medium brown. While foam bun makers would show through splits in the hair in an unattractive way, with this type the effect is more like subtle highlights. So far, so good. If my experience becomes negative, I will update my review.

reviews.t: Not a solution for fine hair.
reviews.x: If you're like me and you bought this item because you have fine hair and wanted an assist in making a nice bun - don't do it.  Item is very heavy, too heavy for my hair to hold up in fact so I can't use it unless I pinned the crap out of it - not an ideal situation for someone with fine hair that breaks easily.

My 5 year old granddaughter's ballet recital was such a success for her.  She has very thin hair and couldn't have the same bun-head as everyone else.  Very close to her own hair color and she told everyone she had a wig!

I had really high hopes for this product and I wasn't disappointed when it arrived. I'm in a play and my character calls for this type of hairstyle. Since my hair is short, a bun with my own hair was out of the question. With this product, I can pull my natural hair into a small pony/messy bun and this product slips right over it. My character gets in a struggling match on stage and with just a few bobby pins, this product really stays secure. It matches my hair perfectly...so well that my own m

I have two main complaints with this piece. 1) The blonde color looks too bleached out and consequently is very plastic looking... Think Barbie doll hair. When I was a brunette I loved my brunette bun cause it didn't matter if the bun poked through. But the color is so fake on this one, it is super obvious when my hair doesn't cover all of it. It's so terrible that I can't even use it

reviews.t: Unnatural color and hard to roll
reviews.x: I wanted to like this, since my own hair is fine and I'm always afraid my donut will show through, but I don't. First off, the color is a very unnaturally light shade, almost white, and it would be as obvious as a sock. Also I find it hard to roll from the end of my ponytail, which is very easy with a mesh donut.

Functionally it works for making a hair bun but the color was substantially lighter than shown. When I told their customer service they said that it was fine since it doesn't have to match perfectly. The color shows through and is obvious that it is way lighter than my own hair. This was "light brown"

reviews.t: Yes it is fake hair so it is super shiny. I sprayed it down with hairspray and ...
reviews.x: Yes it is fake hair so it is super shiny.  I sprayed it down with hairspray and dry shampoo.  Now it's perfect.  I recently was at a job interview with someone who had one of these but the one that looks like foam and it was really showing.  I love how this just looks like more hair if there are some spaces.

reviews.t: My daughter has blonde hair so she ordered blonde since it looked like a dirty blonde in the picture
reviews.x: The color is not as its stated. My daughter has blonde hair so she ordered blonde since it looked like a dirty blonde in the picture. It came today and it's a white blonde. Will now have to return and find what we need locally.

reviews.t: I purchased one of these to keep my military bun ...
reviews.x: I purchased one of these to keep my military bun squared away and it matched my hair perfectly! It lasted about a year before it was too snarled and pulled apart. Both had lightning fast shipping.
I like this a lot because it looks more real then the foam buns.  I always hated when my hair would separate and I could see the foam bun underneath, but this blends in!  love it.

reviews.t: I have such thin + fine hair, I can't use those foam or mesh ...
reviews.x: I have such thin + fine hair, I can't use those foam or mesh donuts because the plastic shows through. This bun doesn't 100% match my hair color, but it still fools everyone.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how well the bun blends with their natural hair, especially for thin or fine hair where foam bun makers would show through.
Many customers find it easy and fast to use for creating a quick, neat bun, including those with short hair or military requirements.
Several reviewers note the color is off from expectations, appearing more copper, gold, or bright yellow than described, and the synthetic hair is shinier than natural.
Durability is a common complaint, with multiple reviewers reporting the product wears out or becomes ratty after about one to two months of use.
Some customers with fine hair find the product too heavy or slick to hold a bun securely without excessive pinning.
